lenses.label: Loop engineering

proposals.title: Monitor 75 automation loop(s) with no known last run
proposals.why: a loop nobody can see is a loop that can fail silently
plan: add bin/brain harness trace <name> ok|fail as the loop's last step
or record its last run in docs/inventory

plan: when Steven edits a draft, save the before/after as a lesson: bin/brain remember "edit lesson: …"
